scope.summary: Populate the service-local Cloud IAM OpenAPI contract from the existing Rust Cloud IAM API surfaces and add a Buck2 parity gate so routes, surfaces, public boundary headers, server-owned metadata, and Cedar ingress authority cannot regress to an empty scaffold.
explicit_non_claims: No KMS or Secrets runtime behavior changed.
No cloud provider, Kubernetes cluster, database, or secret store was contacted.
No generated JSON artifact was added or hand-edited.
No new dependency, Cargo manifest, shared workflow, generated-artifact policy, or root hub spec was changed.

The ADR-0559 and reachability-registry edits are gate-data traceability only: exact path justification plus a narrow cloud/cloud-iam/contracts/ reachability seed required by cloud-ci-total-accounting.

The Cloud IAM OpenAPI is the public ingress contract aligned with existing iam/ports/cloud-api surfaces; it intentionally omits server-owned principal/authz/time fields that an ingress adapter must populate before calling the Rust boundary.
This slice does not claim an axum/router delivery adapter exists for Cloud IAM.
scope.shared_evidence_touch: evidence/audit-chain.jsonl was append-only updated solely to satisfy docs/AGENTS.md D16 audit-chain emission evidence for the PR.

facets.F1_correctness: The Cloud IAM service-local OpenAPI no longer has paths: {}; it declares concrete paths for existing iam/ports/cloud-api surfaces, keeps version/idempotency/tenant/placement headers visible, and forbids public caller-supplied internal authz headers.
facets.F2_tests: TDD red was observed when the new Buck2 contract parity test failed on the empty paths scaffold; after OpenAPI implementation the same target passed.
facets.F3_maintainability: The parity check is contract-local under cloud/cloud-iam/contracts and imports only canonical Rust surface constants from iam/ports/cloud-api.
facets.F4_compatibility: No existing Rust API behavior or Cargo workspace metadata changed; the OpenAPI follows existing public API version values and status semantics.
facets.F5_security: No credentials or secret material were added. Every operation requires bearerAuth and declares server-owned Cedar/PDP decision authority; the parity gate rejects public X-Authorization-* and X-Principal-* headers.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant/user data processing changed. The contract keeps tenant identifiers as public boundary fields, leaves principal/authz context server-owned, and restricts role data_class to PUBLIC, matching the Rust kernel.
facets.F7_operability: The contract exposes request ids, idempotency, placement, status codes, and error envelopes needed for operational diagnosis.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path or data-plane code changed; the added parity gate is a compile-time include_str string check over one YAML file.
facets.F9_compliance: The service contract now provides API evidence for identity provider lifecycle, roles, STS, and default-deny Cedar ingress authority without trusting caller-supplied decision headers.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of one contract, one local BUCK target, one test, one audit-chain append row, and this evidence file.
facets.F11_observability: Request id and structured error response fields are contract-visible; no runtime metrics/SLO implementation is claimed.
facets.F13_migration: Moves Cloud IAM from service-local OpenAPI scaffold toward API-first owned-stack migration while keeping implementation in the existing provider-agnostic Rust boundary.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected broad KMS/Secrets/IAM reorg for the first PR; chose the smallest red/yellow gap with a tested Rust backing surface.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: The slice improves hyperscaler parity by making Cloud IAM external API shape inspectable and preventing silent regression to an empty scaffold.

findings_resolved: Removed public caller-supplied X-Principal-* and X-Authorization-* headers; each operation now declares server-owned ingress_pdp_cedar_decision authority and the Buck2 parity gate rejects those public headers.
Removed client-controlled created_at_epoch_seconds and issued_at_epoch_seconds from public request schemas; records still expose server-owned timestamps.
Strengthened contract-local Buck2 test from global string checks to per-operation route/surface/header/status/schema assertions without adding dependencies.
Added message_localized to ErrorResponse to match the Rust Cloud IAM API error body.
